note: The single source of truth for what the site may claim. Every feature is shipped or soon; the page labels the soon ones. Change a status here and every page follows.

groups.name: Patterns
groups.line: Set the layout once. Lock what the brand decided.

groups.name: Swatches
groups.line: One brand kit, shared by every Pattern.

groups.name: Yarn
groups.line: Your photos, logos, video and copy, kept per project.

groups.name: Parts
groups.line: Small reusable pieces that drop into many Patterns.

groups.name: Motion
groups.line: Animation that is built frame by frame, so it eases like real motion.

groups.name: Voice
groups.line: Voiceover that is made on your own computer.

groups.name: Your model
groups.line: The same tools for you and for your model.

groups.name: The studio

features.name: Locked and free stitches
features.summary: A locked stitch cannot be changed by whoever uses the Pattern, and that includes your model. The attempt is refused and reported.

features.name: The Pattern editor
features.summary: Draw, move and style stitches on a canvas, with the locked and free outlines always visible.

features.name: Fill mode
features.summary: Open a Pattern, change only the free stitches, and knit. Built for people who are not designers.

features.name: Batch knitting in the studio
features.summary: Knit twelve posts from one Pattern in one go. Your model can already ask for variants through the MCP server.

features.name: The Swatch editor
features.summary: Colours, fonts, logos and a written voice for one brand, in one place. Start one from the brand's website.

features.name: Yarn uploads
features.summary: Drop in photos, logos, video and copy. Every file lives in a folder you can open.

features.name: Parts
features.summary: A lower-third, a logo sting or a quote block, made once and dropped into many Patterns.

features.name: The frame-by-frame render engine
features.summary: A Pattern is a page with a timeline. The engine sets the time, takes a picture of each frame and lets ffmpeg do the encoding. Needs Playwright and ffmpeg installed.

features.name: Motion in the editor
features.summary: Set timing and easing on a timeline, then scrub through it before you knit.

features.name: Local voiceover
features.summary: Point the studio at a speech model running on your own computer and add a voice to a reel.

features.name: A four-tool MCP server
features.summary: list_projects, get_pattern, fill_slots and knit_pattern, against the same store the studio uses.

features.name: Your model inside the studio
features.summary: Bring your own key and ask for changes from a prompt bar next to the canvas.

features.name: A design system built as tokens
features.summary: Colour, type, spacing and the stitch outline are defined once and shared by the studio and this site.

features.name: Projects
features.summary: Several brands, each with its own Swatch, Yarn and Patterns.

features.name: Desktop installers
features.summary: An app for Windows, macOS and Linux, with a first-launch guide. Early builds will be unsigned previews.
